metadata.name: vigilantis
metadata.description: Programmable compliance for Token-2022 tokenized assets, built on Transfer Hooks.

instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Complete the handover: the proposed authority signs and becomes the policy authority.

instructions.name: add_to_allowlist
docs: Add a wallet to a mint's allowlist by creating its `AllowEntry` PDA. The admin, or a holder
of `permission::ALLOWLIST`.

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: add_to_blocklist
docs: Add a wallet to a mint's blocklist by creating its `BlockEntry` PDA. The admin, or a holder
of `permission::BLOCK`.

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: block_wallet
docs: `add_to_blocklist`, recording why: also emits `EnforcementAction` with the issuer's
`reason_code` and `case_ref` (for example a salted hash of its case number).

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: cancel_authority_transfer
docs: Withdraw a pending proposal. Only the current authority may call this.

instructions.name: close_seizure
docs: Close a `SeizureRecord` once the case is settled, recording the outcome. The admin, or a
holder of `permission::CLOSE_SEIZURE`. The record's rent goes to the signer; the events of
the seizure and of its closing stay in the chain's history.

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: freeze_token_account
docs: Freeze one token account of the mint: Token-2022 then refuses every instruction on it
(transfers in and out, burns, approvals, confidential deposits, transfers and withdrawals)
until it is thawed. The admin, or a holder of `permission::FREEZE`, and only for a mint
whose freeze authority is Vigilantis's freeze-authority address for that mint.
Also writes the account's `FreezeRecord` (the time of this freeze), which `seize` needs; the
signer pays its rent.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin or a role holder; pays for the `FreezeRecord` of a freeze and gets it back on a
thaw.

accounts.name: token_account
docs: program, mint, current state); Vigilantis only reads its owner for the event.

accounts.name: freeze_record
docs: by a thaw; it may not exist (an account frozen before 1.0 or by another freeze authority).

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: grant_role
docs: Give `holder` a role with `permissions` (bits of [`permission`]). The admin only.

instructions.name: initialize_extra_account_meta_list
docs: Create and initialize the `ExtraAccountMetaList` PDA for `mint`, declaring
the accounts the hook needs on every transfer: the policy config, the
sender's and recipient's blocklist entries, and the recipient's allowlist
entry (all resolved from the transfer's own accounts).

instructions.name: initialize_policy
docs: Create the mint's `PolicyConfig`. The signer becomes its authority.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Stop the whole token: Token-2022 then refuses every transfer, mint and burn of it,
confidential ones included, until `resume`. Freezing and thawing still work. The admin, or a
holder of `permission::PAUSE`, and only for a Pausable mint whose pause authority is
Vigilantis's pause-authority address for that mint.

accounts.name: mint
docs: and Token-2022 checks the rest.

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: Start handing the policy to `new_authority` (for example a multisig vault). Nothing
changes until `new_authority` accepts, so a mistyped address cannot lock the policy.

instructions.name: remove_from_allowlist
docs: Remove a wallet from a mint's allowlist by closing its `AllowEntry` PDA. The admin, or a
holder of `permission::ALLOWLIST`.

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: remove_from_blocklist
docs: Remove a wallet from a mint's blocklist by closing its `BlockEntry` PDA. The admin, or a
holder of `permission::UNBLOCK`.

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: renounce_role
docs: Give up one's own role, for example when its key may be stolen. Signed by the holder; the
rent goes to the holder.

instructions.name: resume
docs: End a pause. The admin, or a holder of `permission::RESUME`.

accounts.name: mint
docs: and Token-2022 checks the rest.

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: revoke_role
docs: Take a role away. The admin only; the rent goes to the admin.

instructions.name: seize
docs: Burn the public balance of a token account under a court order. The admin, or a holder of
`permission::SEIZE`; `case_ref` must not be all zeros.
The account must have been frozen through Vigilantis at least `SEIZE_DELAY_SECONDS` before
and still be frozen, and the mint's permanent delegate must be Vigilantis's
permanent-delegate address. In one instruction Vigilantis thaws the account, burns its whole
public balance as the permanent delegate, and freezes it again. The reserve behind the burnt
tokens stays with the issuer for the case; paying out under the judgment is a separate step.
A `SeizureRecord` stays open until `close_seizure`. A confidential balance is not touched.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin or a role holder; pays for the `SeizureRecord`.

accounts.name: token_account
docs: and Token-2022 checks it again in the thaw, burn and freeze.

accounts.name: freeze_record
docs: When Vigilantis froze `token_account`; without one, the account cannot be seized.

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: set_freeze_authority
docs: Hand the mint's freeze authority from Vigilantis to `new_freeze_authority` (for example a
newer compliance program, or the issuer's own multisig), or give it up for good with `None`.
Only the policy authority may do this, and only while Vigilantis holds the freeze authority.
From then on Vigilantis can no longer freeze or thaw the mint's accounts; whoever holds the
freeze authority can hand it back with Token-2022 `SetAuthority`. The move is recorded in
`FreezeAuthorityChanged`, with the issuer's reason.

instructions.name: set_pause_authority
docs: Hand the mint's pause authority from Vigilantis to `new_pause_authority`, or give it up for
good with `None`. The admin only, and only while Vigilantis holds the pause authority. The
move is recorded in `PauseAuthorityChanged`.

instructions.name: thaw_token_account
docs: Thaw a token account frozen with `freeze_token_account` (or by any earlier holder of the
mint's freeze authority). The admin, or a holder of `permission::THAW`. Deletes the
account's `FreezeRecord`, if there is one, and returns its rent to the signer.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin or a role holder; pays for the `FreezeRecord` of a freeze and gets it back on a
thaw.

accounts.name: token_account
docs: program, mint, current state); Vigilantis only reads its owner for the event.

accounts.name: freeze_record
docs: by a thaw; it may not exist (an account frozen before 1.0 or by another freeze authority).

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: transfer_hook
docs: Invoked by Token-2022 on every transfer. Enforces the mint's policy.
A refusal emits `TransferRefused` before returning the error, so indexers can read the
reason from the failed transaction's logs.

instructions.name: unblock_wallet
docs: `remove_from_blocklist`, recording why (`EnforcementAction`).

accounts.name: role
docs: The signer's `RoleEntry` for this mint, when the signer is not the admin.

instructions.name: update_extra_account_meta_list
docs: Rewrite a mint's `ExtraAccountMetaList` to the current list, growing the account if
needed. Mints initialized before 2.1 run this once so the hook also receives the transfer
authority's blocklist entry. The list's content is fixed by the program; only the policy
authority may trigger the rewrite, and it pays for any extra rent.

instructions.name: update_policy
docs: Update the mint's policy. Only the policy authority may call this.

instructions.name: update_role
docs: Change the permissions of an existing role. The admin only.

errors.name: RecipientNotAllowlisted
errors.msg: Recipient is not on the allowlist for this mint

errors.name: TransferExceedsLimit
errors.msg: Transfer amount exceeds the policy limit

errors.name: SenderBlocked
errors.msg: Sender is blocklisted for this mint

errors.name: RecipientBlocked
errors.msg: Recipient is blocklisted for this mint

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: The signer is neither the policy authority nor a role holder with this permission

errors.name: ConfidentialAmountNotEnforceable
errors.msg: This mint sets a transfer limit, which cannot be enforced on a confidential transfer; set allow_confidential on the policy to permit them

errors.name: AuthorityBlocked
errors.msg: The transfer authority (a delegate of the source account) is blocklisted for this mint

errors.name: InvalidAuthority
errors.msg: The new authority must be a real address and differ from the current one

errors.name: FreezeAuthorityNotVigilantis
errors.msg: The mint's freeze authority is not Vigilantis's freeze-authority address for this mint

errors.name: InvalidPermissions
errors.msg: A role needs at least one permission, and only known ones

errors.name: PauseAuthorityNotVigilantis
errors.msg: The mint is not Pausable, or its pause authority is not Vigilantis's pause-authority address for this mint

errors.name: PermanentDelegateNotVigilantis
errors.msg: The mint's permanent delegate is not Vigilantis's permanent-delegate address for this mint

errors.name: AccountNotFrozen
errors.msg: The token account is not frozen

errors.name: NothingToSeize
errors.msg: The token account has no public balance to seize

errors.name: SeizeTooEarly
errors.msg: The token account was frozen through Vigilantis less than 24 hours ago

errors.name: InvalidCaseRef
errors.msg: A seizure needs a case reference

errors.name: InvalidTokenAccount
errors.msg: Not a token account of this mint

errors.name: NotInTransfer
errors.msg: The transfer hook was called outside a Token-2022 transfer of this mint

errors.name: OwnerCanChange
errors.msg: A token account of this mint must have an owner that cannot change (the ImmutableOwner extension, which every associated token account has)

errors.name: PausedMintHandover
errors.msg: Resume the mint before handing on or giving up its pause authority

types.name: AllowEntry
docs: An allowlist entry: its existence means `wallet` may receive `mint`.

types.name: BlockEntry
docs: A blocklist entry: its existence means `wallet` may neither send nor receive `mint`.

types.name: EnforcementAction
docs: Emitted by `block_wallet`, `unblock_wallet`, `freeze_token_account`, `thaw_token_account`,
`pause`, `resume`, `seize` and `close_seizure`: what was done, to whom, and the issuer's reason. Vigilantis does not interpret `reason_code`;
`case_ref` points to the issuer's own case file (for example a salted hash of its case number),
so no personal data needs to go on-chain.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The blocked or unblocked wallet, or the owner of the frozen, thawed or seized token account;
the default address for a pause or resume.

fields.name: token_account
docs: The frozen, thawed or seized token account; the default address for a block, unblock, pause
or resume.

types.name: EnforcementKind
docs: What an `EnforcementAction` did.

types.name: FreezeAuthorityChanged
docs: Emitted by `set_freeze_authority` (2.3): Vigilantis handed the mint's freeze authority to
`new_freeze_authority`, or gave it up (`None`). Freezes after this are no longer Vigilantis's.

types.name: FreezeRecord
docs: When Vigilantis last froze `token_account`. Written by `freeze_token_account`, deleted by
`thaw_token_account`, read by `seize`.

fields.name: frozen_at
docs: Unix time of the freeze.

types.name: ListKind
docs: Which list an entry belongs to.

types.name: PauseAuthorityChanged
docs: Emitted by `set_pause_authority`: Vigilantis handed the mint's pause authority to
`new_pause_authority`, or gave it up (`None`).

types.name: PendingAuthority
docs: A proposed handover of a mint's policy authority, waiting for `new_authority` to accept.

types.name: PolicyConfig
docs: Per-mint compliance policy: which rules are active and their parameters.

fields.name: allow_confidential
docs: Permit confidential transfers on a mint that also sets
`max_transfer_amount`. The limit cannot be enforced on an encrypted
amount, so the issuer opts in to that gap explicitly. Irrelevant when no
limit is set, because there is then nothing to enforce.

fields.name: role_epoch
docs: Increased by every `accept_authority`. A role works only while its `epoch` equals this, so
a handover of the policy ends every role granted before it.

types.name: RoleChanged
docs: Emitted by `grant_role`, `update_role`, `revoke_role` and `renounce_role`. `permissions` is 0
when the role is gone; `authority` is the admin, or the holder for a renounce.

types.name: RoleEntry
docs: A role: `holder` may do the actions in `permissions` (bits of [`permission`]) for `mint`.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The policy's `role_epoch` when the role was granted or last updated. The role works only
while the two are equal.

types.name: Seized
docs: Emitted by `seize`, next to `EnforcementAction`: how much public balance was burnt.

types.name: SeizureClosed
docs: Emitted by `close_seizure`, next to `EnforcementAction`.

types.name: SeizureOutcome
docs: How a seizure ended, recorded by `close_seizure`.

types.name: SeizureRecord
docs: An open seizure: `amount` of `wallet`'s public balance in `token_account` was burnt. Closed by
`close_seizure` once the case is settled.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The owner of the token account at the time of the seizure.

fields.name: authority
docs: Who seized.

fields.name: seized_at
docs: Unix time of the seizure.

types.name: TransferRefused
docs: Emitted by the hook just before it refuses a transfer. The transaction fails, but its logs
(and this event) stay readable. `error_code` is the `VigilantisError` code, e.g. 6003.
